title: Round 18: round 7's DAgger students (beliefs p and q) on net1 v6
description: On net1 v6, PPO learned from the reward clears both competition conditions but loses 0.26 to 0.30 as copies, averaged over seeds or not (exp-net2-eval-v6-159, exp-net2-eval-v6-ens-160): it pushes where a full queue with a low share could be copies or a loss-based flow. The one learned net2 that passed its gate, round 7e on net1 v5, did so with explicit beliefs: DAgger students that learn p, that a stock TCP flow shares the link, and q, that copies do, from a privileged teacher, run as one policy on three seeds' mean beliefs with q vetoing the push. Round 18 trains round 7's students unchanged on net1 v6 (release exp-net1v6-149, its rule at u = 0.25): teacher gain 0.5 and 1, seeds 1 to 3. Their exports are a v6 counterpart of round 7e, and their q can veto a PPO policy's push. Validation links only.
run: S="$OUT/spec-r18-k$K-s$SEED.json"; jq --argjson k "$K" --argjson seed "$SEED" '.algo = "dagger" | .student = "gate3" | .base = "fixed" | .share_k = $k | .gate_threshold = 0.5 | .critic_warmup = 0 | .lr = 0.001 | .updates_per_iteration = 50 | .replay_iterations = 16 | .tau_s = 1 | .noise_sigma = 0.05 | .group = 1 | .links_per_iteration = 32 | .compete = 0.8 | .copies = [2, 4] | .seed = $seed | .iterations = 60 | .eval_every = 20' "$OUT/setup/ppo-base.json" > "$S"; uv run expliccit train ppo "$S" "$OUT/ppo-r18-k$K-s$SEED" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS"
